name: account-review
title: Account performance review draft
for_each: select id,name from accounts order by ref

sections.title: Account and reporting scope
sections.sql: select name,platform,currency,owner from accounts where id=$1

sections.title: Latest exported performance
sections.note: One reporting window only. Missing metrics stay unknown. Confirm the conversion definition before interpreting results.

sections.title: Approved budget review
sections.sql: select ref,currency,measured_through,budget_cents,cost_cents,projected_cents,review from budget_pacing where id in(select id from budget_plans where account_id=$1)

sections.title: Next work
sections.sql: select ref,title,owner,due_date,status from actions where account_id=$1 order by due_date

sections.title: Operator notes
sections.sql: select author,body,created_at from notes where account_id=$1 order by created_at

name: change-brief
title: Campaign change brief draft
for_each: select id,ref from actions order by ref

sections.title: Requested decision
sections.note: This document does not execute a campaign change or grant publishing permission.
sections.sql: select x.ref,a.name,a.currency,x.title,x.owner,x.due_date,x.proposed_change,x.rationale,x.status from actions x join accounts a on a.id=x.account_id where x.id=$1
